attchmntText: GSS Infotech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: GSS Infotech Limited board approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations was 129.99 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to 153.78 lakhs in the previous quarter. Profit after tax for the quarter was a loss of 17.70 lakhs, versus a profit of 20.49 lakhs in the prior quarter. Year to date revenue stood at 283.78 lakhs with a profit after tax of 2.79 lakhs. The statutory auditors, M/s. Rambabu & Co., issued a limited review report on the results. The board meeting concluded at 08.45 PM on 14th November 2026.
